## Environment fingerprint

- Framework `objectstack-ai/objectstack` main @ **`8e3d4a54`** (replaces a596c03c; nothing at a596c03c is scored). Fresh tree: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm build --concurrency=2`, `pnpm console:build`, showcase compiled once (09:07–09:10Z). The console served by `/_console/` is byte-identical to `packages/console/dist`.
- Boots: `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin --no-compile --no-watch -p PORT -d file:/tmp/qa3/A/<runner>/<db>` with `OS_PORT` / `OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT` exported, stopped by process group, one boot per runner at a time. Installs and fixture apps from scratch copies; `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/installed-packages` absent throughout; `git status` clean at the end. Ports 41210–41249.
- Special boots: walled `isolated` and `group` (no-active-org, walled-environment-metadata); a scratch Postgres (datasource-credential-refusal-matrix); a v17 database written by npm `create-objectstack@17.7.0` with every dependency pinned to 17.7.0 and booted once by its own `os dev --seed-admin` (v18-boot-refusals, ownership ceremony; golden v17.db sha256 `b090628a…78cd8`); the cli-18-prerelease-db recipe restore under `--dev` (ceremony A5).
- Execution: Tier 1 pins run centrally (sequential vitest `--maxWorkers=1` per package, 19 groups, cli e2e under `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly`): **3,403 tests, 3,400 passed, 0 failed, 3 skipped by design** (rls-multitenant ×2 — `describe.skipIf(!organizationsAvailable)`, the organizations runtime is not resolvable in the open workspace; activation-ledger-package-key ×1 — `it.skipIf` memory driver). Tier 2 by 3 runner subagents (effort high): api (12 items), browser/mixed (8), cli (4, beside the upgrade slice).
- Timestamps (UTC): build 09:07–09:10; pins 09:12–09:30; api runner 09:12–09:28 (setup ≈5 min, test ≈17); browser runner 09:11–10:01 (setup ≈12, test ≈38); cli runner 09:11–10:00 shared with A-UPG (setup ≈30 incl. the 17.7.0 install, test ≈55).

## Scope

Selector `priority:P0` at 8e3d4a54 → 24 items, all judged. Revisions (all equal to the resolver's): rls-both-sides 11 · write-path-guards 9 · crud-permission-matrix 13 · owd-sharing-matrix 9 · anonymous-deny-surfaces 5 · no-active-org-session-semantics 10 · walled-environment-metadata-operator-only 8 · query-contract-matrix 9 · packaged-action-disabled-dispatch 13 · packaged-flow-disable-durable 10 · default-organization-boot-invariant 4 · seed-integrity 7 · mcp-stdio-fail-closed 9 · dev-boot-contract 9 · organization-ownership-ceremony 9 · v18-boot-refusals 9 · account-app-entry 9 · console-login 5 · nav-surfaces-render 10 · builtin-apps-nav-render 13 · crud-roundtrip 18 · first-run-loop 13 · boot-health 14 · datasource-credential-refusal-matrix 9.

## #32955 re-drive (round 1 FAIL #32953, approvals.account-app-entry [3], [4])

Fixed at 8e3d4a54 (8004529e). A non-admin invited contributor (showcase_contributor + showcase_finance, no setup app) who is a pending approver on two fresh `flow:showcase_invoice_signoff` requests: `GET /api/v1/meta/object/sys_approval_request` → **200** on curl and on every in-page load; Approve / Reject render from the inbox row, from a cold-loaded `?request=` link and from a cold load of the record URL; "Object Not Found" never appears. Approve moves progress 0 of 2 → 1 of 2, drops the persona from pending_approvers and turns `viewer.can_act` false; the buttons are gone after a reload.

## Fails — reproduction rule and disposition

None.

## Off-clause probes (rule 8)

Every runner kept a probe budget after each item (2–5 min); per-item minutes and doors are in the probe log (record-A-P0-clauses-1.md). No product defect found; no card drafted.

Observed and not carded (low, for the seat to weigh): the stock boot logs a `[sharing-rule]` warning that `showcase_share_new_inquiries_with_field_ops` expands to no recipients; on the single posture `admin/create-user` answers `membershipCreated:false` while a `sys_member` row (role member) exists immediately afterwards; `os dev` over a v17 copy upgrades it in place with a backup (the documented ADR-0131 D10 development exception, not a finding); a plugin driver's credentials sit in cleartext in sys_metadata at rest while every read door redacts them (the boundary ruled in #21921).

## Parked-on #32908

Fixture gaps: a member-less user on a walled boot (no-active-org A0 producer (1)); the D11 private write-up (#7463); a guest-anchor binding door (#23267); the cli-18-prerelease-db recipe does not re-date rotation shards, so its `sys_activity__r20261027` shard (66 rows) now falls outside the 7-day window and the first refused boot drops it by designed retention (restore through fixture-as-of); marketplace catalog content blocked(environment) by the egress proxy (named "Failed to load marketplace" state, as the knownGap expects).

Per-item checklist-accuracy notes follow.

**access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics**
- steps[8] says the member "creates a showcase_account and a showcase_project in A": a baseline member (showcase_member_default) cannot create either (403 PERMISSION_DENIED with A active). The run had the operator create them in A; the member's own create was the showcase_task, as the clause requires. The step should name who creates the parents or grant the member a set that can.
- A re-sign-in after the clear starts a session with an active organization again (the member's next session read activeOrganizationId = A), so a run must clear per session.

**access-security.walled-environment-metadata-operator-only**
- The org owner already holds `organization_admin` in its own organization automatically (sys_user_permission_set row reason "auto-org-admin-grant: granted from membership grade 'owner'"), so the persona in this run held manage_metadata (fixture row) plus organization_admin — still not platform admin. Not a defect; noted so the persona's grants are explicit.
- install-local leg not driven live (knownGaps[1]: scored from the pins; it would need a scratch-copy boot).

**approvals.account-app-entry**
- A3/A4 app segment: the request page opens under **com.example.showcase**, not the inbox's com.objectstack.account. This is by design since objectstack#32667 (ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx requestPagePath → objectHostAppSegment: the app that lists the request's record object, showcase_invoice → Showcase). A4.verify's "/apps/<appId>/sys_approval_request/record/<id>" reads as the component route's appId — stale wording; scored on the clause (lands on that request's page, replaced in history, parity wit…
- A6: the picker offers "简体中文" and stores locale zh-Hans; the item says "中文（中国） … code zh-CN". Wording stale; the clause's strings all hold.
- The persona is the inbox SUBMITTER as well as an approver (its own invoice, per fixtures.requires for A5), so the request page also renders Recall/Reply; harmless, noted.

**cli.dev-boot-contract**
- steps[6]/A2: with OS_HOME exported (the per-boot isolation many runners use), the nothing-chosen Database line is `file:$OS_HOME/data/objectstack.db`, not the project's `.objectstack/data/objectstack.db` (measured: `file:/tmp/qa3/A/ap0c/home-dev/data/objectstack.db`). The clause's "<state dir>" covers it, but the step should say "with OS_HOME unset" so a runner does not misread the line.

**cli.organization-ownership-ceremony**
- A5 stale spec: the post-upgrade delivery's ref_id is `declared:com.example.showcase/showcase_task_changed`, not the clause's `declared:showcase_task_changed` — the ADR-0150 D5 (#31699, #32577) package-qualified subscription id (`declaredWebhookRefId(name, packageId)`, packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/declared-webhooks.ts). Product right; the clause should read `declared:com.example.showcase/showcase_task_changed` (or `declared:[PKG/]showcase_task_changed`).
- Fixture gap (cli-18-prerelease-db recipe): the restore does not re-date rotation shards, so the restored telemetry sibling carries `sys_activity__r20261027` (66 rows), which by 2026-11-13 is outside the 7-day rotation window; the FIRST boot (the refused one, before any plan) drops it via driver-sql ensureRotation retention (designed; packages/qa/dogfood/test/upgrade-harness/fixture-as-of.ts exists for exactly this in the harness, but `restore` does not apply it). So "no row disappears outside…
- recipe knownGaps[1] says the moved mails' attempt_count goes 2 → 3 on the second boot; this run read status `failed`, attempt_count 4 in sys_identity_email after the second boot (retry against the closed SMTP port) — same class, digits differ.

**identity-auth.default-organization-boot-invariant**
- The admin/create-user answer carries `membershipCreated:false` together with `organizationId: org_mwerd5s8ogmxyh1c`, yet a sys_member row (role member) exists for that user immediately after — the membership is made by another path (the single-posture default-org binding), not by create-user itself. Not a clause defect (the clause reads sys_member), but a reader of the create-user body alone would conclude the user has no membership.
- Boot log also warns `[sharing-rule] active business-unit rule expands to NO recipients … sys_business_unit_member rows written by seed replay … are not organization-stamped` (rule showcase_share_new_inquiries_with_field_ops, organization null) — outside this item's clauses (sys_business_unit_member is not sampled by A3), noted for the record.

**integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix**
- Code-author env route (OS_DATASOURCE_*_PASSWORD) and the external.connector channel: not covered by this item (knownGaps[5]), not driven.
- At rest, a plugin driver's config keeps its canonical credentials as written in sys_metadata (read via node:sqlite: url userinfo, password, authToken present) while every read door redacts them — the ruled boundary (#21921: the write door accepts plugin config unvalidated); noted, not scored.

**platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render**
- Counts moved: Setup now serves **48** leaves (steps[5] says 46) and **11** settings namespaces — `access_policy` (nav_settings_access_policy, "Access policy — This organization's sign-in restrictions") is new beside the 10 steps[3] lists. Recount, not a finding.
- Marketplace catalog content: blocked(environment) — egress proxy, the named error renders (knownGap).

**records-forms.crud-roundtrip**
- After Create the console lands on the new record page, not the list; acceptance[3]'s "post-reload screenshot of the list at create" needs an explicit list navigation + reload (run r1's reload was of the record page; r2 did it properly). Minor step wording.
- Industry defaults to Technology on the create form, so steps[1]'s "fill industry" is satisfied by the default unless another value is picked.

**studio-authoring.first-run-loop**
- The en leg used display name 'Repair Center Pkg' (zh leg 维修中心); the id/namespace the clauses read are identical (com.example.repairs / repairs).
- Picklist option names in the zh type picker: 下拉选择 (Picklist); the author-entered labels (Status, Received…) stay as typed, so the zh end-user list shows "In Repair" — the authored label, correct.
